Theorem
[Lax--Oleinik formula as integral solution] ↗ thm:lax-oleinik-formula ↗ def:integral-solution-conservation-law 1. ch3:3.4-thm-2\group Conservation Laws

The Lax--Oleinik function is an integral solution of the conservation-law initial-value problem.

Proof

\sketch Apply the a.e. Hamilton–Jacobi equation for $w$ to a test function derivative $v_x$, integrate by parts in $x$ and $t$, and use $w(\cdot ,0)=h$ and $h_x=g$. Since $u=w_x$ a.e., the resulting identity is the integral solution identity.

□
